limitations: Profiles add overhead; inclusive nested timings must not be summed.
Asset release probes run after one populated late-round battle, not a complete tournament.
Cache clearing and reduced shadow settings are diagnostic only; production quality and cache behavior are unchanged.
The final root-world assignment in the extended diagnostic logged a null-scenario error. All cache and shadow observations precede it; that assignment is not a proposed change.
RenderingServer video allocation is driver VMA allocated bytes, not a precise measure of resident VRAM or exclusively application assets.

mode_switch_comparison.scope: Three populated late-round battles, then stationary reload of the saved 81-corpse traversal endpoint. Not three full games or another gameplay traversal.
mode_switch_comparison.comparison_intervals: Four full samples ending around 30, 60, 90 and 120 seconds; excludes initial single frame and the owner-only 150-second sample.
